_readme: Comfy Cloud workflows DWARP can run. One entry per graph; the graph itself is a ComfyUI workflow
saved in API format (Workflow -> Export (API)) sitting next to this file.
An entry says where DWARP's own values go, by node id and input name, so the engine never has to
know what the graph is made of:
graph   the API-format file in this folder
short   one word for run labels, as in "h3 · render"
saver   the node whose output IS the render. Read outputs from this one only: a LoadVideo node
reports the file it read in the same shape as a real output and would otherwise win.
prompt  [node, input] the text goes on
seed    [node, input] the seed goes on (optional)
node    the model node that carries size, length and the reference slots
size    megapixels + multiple the width/height are fitted to, and the input names
length  frame count: the model's fps, its frame-count step (snap) and floor, and the lengths to
offer on the panel. A model that takes seconds instead can set "unit": "seconds".
refs    the auto-growing picture slots: a {i} template, the prefix to clear first, and how many
video   the slot a source clip goes in, and the one its sound goes in
sound   whether the file it writes has audio at all
Leave a key out and that control disappears from the panel.

workflows.label: H3 · Pika Flex
workflows.note: Reference to video, with sound. Up to nine pictures and your clip go in; a new 5-15 s clip comes out, picture and audio made together. Six sampling steps, native 1344x768.
